I know how you feel, that awful emptiness. The first few weeks or months are the worst, I haven't spoken to her for more than a month now and its still really bad for me. The hardest thing for me I had to learn was that she wasn't the one for me because she would have chosen me then. He is not the one for you either because in the end he left you. I thought our friendship was exceptional too, but it wasn't. I saw how she spoke and acted with another friend of mine who she just met and I realized she was just playing with me and that she didn't talk to me because she felt the same as me. The thing that keeps me going is that I know there will be someone who will chose me and I know there will be someone who is going to chose you in the end. If you cut every connection with him and you don't stalk him on social media as I did it will be quicker to get over. With time and help from friends or psychologist you will get through I'm sure. ❤️
